name: Managing Time
overview: Scripture teaches that managing time wisely is essential for living a God-honoring life, as we are reminded to number our days to gain wisdom (Psalms 90:12) and recognize that every activity has its appointed season (Ecclesiastes 3:1). While our plans are important, the Lord ultimately directs our steps (Proverbs 16:9), calling us to seek first His kingdom and righteousness above all else (Matthew 6:33). Believers are urged to redeem the time by walking in wisdom, especially in a world characterized by evil, making purposeful use of every opportunity (Ephesians 5:16; Colossians 4:5).
